name: AKANKSHA DILEEP NITTURE
bio:
Career Overview: Playing Style: A crafty player with a deceptive serve, effective drop shots, and a strong mental game, suited to hard courts.
Career-High WTA Singles Ranking: #765 (March 3, 2025), Career-High WTA Doubles Ranking: #825 (December 30, 2024).
Best Grand Slam Singles Performance: Yet to play in a senior Grand Slam main draw.
Notable Achievements: ITF Titles: Won 1 ITF singles title (2024 ITF Open Bengaluru W15) and reached the final of the 2025 ITF W50 Indore (lost to Shrivalli Bhamidipaty). National Success: Secured gold at the 2022 Khelo India Youth Games (singles) and silver in 2020; part of Maharashtra’s gold-medal-winning women’s team at the 2024 National Games. Biggest Win: Defeated World No. 512 Vaishnavi Adkar at 2024 ITF Open Bengaluru SF. Other Highlights: Reached R2 at 2025 WTA 125 Mumbai Open (wildcard) and R2 at ITF W15 Nonthaburi (March 26, 2025). Trains at ASA Academy in Mumbai. Aims for a Top 500 ranking by 2026.
Akanksha’s resilience and recent form mark her as a rising talent in Indian tennis. 🎾🇮🇳
